description:
Link authentication for go-link-desk unattended (reach) access. Each host has an ECDSA P-256 device key; each browser link has its own ECDSA P-256 key. A public key is the 65-byte uncompressed point (0x04||X||Y), a signature is the 64-byte P1363 pair (R||S), both base64url without padding. ECDSA signs the SHA-256 of the message. The messages are: host proof = "go-link-desk host proof v1
"+nonce+"
"+host_fingerprint+"
"+viewer_fingerprint, link proof = "go-link-desk link proof v1
"+..., host unlink = "go-link-desk host unlink v1
"+.... ECDSA signatures are randomized, so a client reproduces the messages and VERIFIES the signatures here against the given public keys (it cannot reproduce the exact bytes). A fingerprint is the first sha-256 a=fingerprint line of that side's SDP, "sha-256 "+UPPERHEX.

fingerprint_cases.sdp:
v=0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
a=fingerprint:sha-512 AA:BB
a=fingerprint:SHA-256 ab:cd:ef
